reopening the form does not greet you with the last place's message
searching by category name finds the places in it

initial state loads the city, its places and its geometry
a fix inside Mumbai flies the map there and the ring follows
toggling wishlist from the map is reflected in progress
search is case insensitive and matches part of a name
a long result list is capped rather than burying the map
the ring reports where it is and the place lands there
picking a result selects it and clears the search out of the way
closing the form forgets the fix, so reopening it does not fly again
